name: Giant Slayer

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 weapon; an extra 2d6 against Giants, which also make a DC 15 Strength save or fall Prone.
text: This magic weapon adds +1 to attack and damage rolls. Against a Giant, a hit deals 2d6 more damage (the weapon's own type), and the Giant must pass a Strength saving throw (DC 15) or gain the Prone condition.
